declarations.name: AuiSessionWarningDialog
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Session Warning Dialog; projected content is added below the countdown:
`<aui-session-warning-dialog [expiresAt]="deadline()" [(open)]="warn" (extended)="extend()">...</aui-session-warning-dialog>`.
With `warnBefore` it opens itself; `open` follows it either way.

inputs.name: warnBefore
inputs.description: Open automatically this long before expiresAt (at least 20 s).

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Default: localized "Your session is about to expire".

inputs.name: expiredMessage
inputs.description: Default: localized "You have been signed out. Sign in again to continue."

inputs.name: signInLabel
inputs.description: The single action after expiry. Default: localized "Sign in again".

inputs.name: announceInterval
inputs.description: Announce the remaining time each time it crosses a multiple of this many seconds (15..3600), and at 60, 30, and 10 seconds.

inputs.name: escapeExtends
inputs.description: Escape means "Stay signed in"; when false, Escape does nothing.

models.name: open
models.description: Whether the warning dialog is shown: `[(open)]`. Closing by Escape, the close button, or an action sets it to false.

outputs.name: extended
outputs.description: The user chose to stay signed in: extend the session, then call update({ expiresAt }).

outputs.name: signedOut
outputs.description: The user chose to sign out, or acknowledged expiry ("Sign in again").

outputs.name: expired
outputs.description: The deadline passed (once per deadline, open or closed).

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA alertdialog (native modal <dialog>) named by its title and described by the message and countdown.

limitations: Background tabs throttle timers; the countdown is recomputed from the clock on the next tick, so it is correct but can update late.
A deadline in the past at creation opens in the expired state without emitting aui-expire.
After the user answers, auto-open is suspended until update({ expiresAt }).
Escape extends the session by default (escapeExtends).
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
